# BURST Oral Care

> BURST Oral Care offers clinically-proven sonic toothbrushes, dental floss, toothpaste, probiotics, and whitening solutions designed for professional-grade oral health at home.

BURST specializes in premium oral care products featuring advanced technologies like sonic brushing, expanding floss, and probiotic formulations. The product line includes solutions for adults and children, with a focus on plaque removal, enamel protection, and natural ingredients.

## Key Topics

- Sonic Toothbrush
- Expanding Floss
- Oral Probiotics

- Enamel Protection

- Xylitol
- BLIS K12 & M18
- Electric Toothbrush

- Cavity Prevention
- USB-C Charging
- Clinical Benefits
- Refill Subscription
